confidence_explanation: The analysis is based on a clear pattern of anomalous behavior by user_02, including logins from an unusual IP address and a significant deviation from their baseline download volume, which strongly suggests data exfiltration.

attack_chain.description: Successful login from an unusual IP address (45.79.97.21) slightly outside normal working hours.
Initial data collection begins with the download of a policy document from project_alpha.
Increased frequency of downloads from project_beta.
Bulk download of engineering plans and migration files.
Continued pattern of downloading large files across both project_alpha and project_beta.
Final download of engineering configuration files before logging out.
User returns the following day from the same unusual IP to continue a high-volume download pattern across engineering and shared project directories.

gaps: Verification of whether the IP 45.79.97.21 is a known corporate VPN or a malicious actor's IP.
Confirmation of whether user_02 was on approved international travel (as noted in baseline) which might explain the IP change.
narrative: User_02 exhibited a highly suspicious pattern of behavior over two days, characterized by logins from an unusual IP address and a massive surge in file downloads. The activity involved systematic reading and downloading of sensitive engineering and project-specific files, far exceeding the user's baseline of 3 downloads per day, indicating a successful data exfiltration incident.
